text:
maria.g: Q3 planning - we need a decision on east region backfill. APAC spike + planned EU promo means hosted API needs ~320 extra V100-equivalent GPU-hours/day for 12 weeks. Buy vs lease mix? :eyes:

chris.k: Can you paste the forecast numbers? I want to run bin packing against current fleet.

maria.g: Sure — quick projection (avg token throughput -> rps -> gpu-hours):

```text
Window: 12 weeks
Peak RPS: 1200 -> Peak concurrent seq=512 throughput ~ 14k tokens/s
Requested headroom: +25% buffer
Estimate: 320 GPU-hours/day (V100 equiv) => ~2680 GPU-hours/week
Total: ~32k GPU-hours for quarter
```

chris.k: Ok. On current fleet that's ~40% of east spare capacity. Options:
- Short-term lease for 12 weeks (fast)
- Buy 40 GPUs (NVIDIA A30 equiv) and use as hybrid + sell/repurpose later
- Burst via partner region routing (latency tradeoff)

I ran quick cost calc — see Ajay pls.

ajay.p: Pinged finance. Rough cost-ballpark:

```text
Option A (lease): ~$1.8M total for 12 weeks (includes rack + bandwidth)
Option B (buy): Capex ~$2.4M + ops ~$200k/yr, depreciation over 3yrs
Option C (burst): network egress + cross-region licenses ~$250k, higher p95 latency
```

Lease moves faster, buy better long-term unit cost (>18 months payback).

sophia.l: From SRE POV: buying requires 8 week lead time for racks + staging + cabling, plus Azure/partner handoff. Also cluster upgrade to support that scale is low-risk but needs extra oncall. Leasing partners can ship in ~2-3 weeks.

chris.k: Hybrid idea: buy 24 GPUs to cover baseline growth, lease additional 16 for Q3 peak. That gives ~60% buy / 40% lease. Pros: reduce capex, still get lower unit cost after buy amortized, faster ramp.

maria.g: Hybrid looks promising. Can we simulate throughput & failure scenarios? We need to ensure p99 < 500ms for standard generation workload.

chris.k: I'll run the sim tonight. Quick results (local sim):

```text
Scenario A (lease-only): p50=120ms p95=410ms p99=620ms
Scenario B (buy24+lease16): p50=110ms p95=380ms p99=480ms
Scenario C (burst-regions): p99 spikes to 900ms due to cross-region KV cache misses
```

maria.g: Good — hybrid keeps p99 under 500ms. Ajay, what's cash impact vs commit thresholds for Dedicated customers?

ajay.p: If we buy 24 now, financing team suggests a 24-month equipment loan — monthly OPEX impact manageable. If we exceed commit we can offer short-term credits to big clients to smooth delta. I'll prepare a 2-slide ROI and cashflow by EOD.

ops-costs-bot: Projection uploaded: https://redwood.internal/ops/capacity/1869001234-hybrid-proj

- [maria.g] confirm 12-week exact window and final GPU-hours
- [chris.k] run formal bin-packing + failure sims (due tomorrow)
- [ajay.p] ROI + cashflow slides due EOD
- [sophia.l] ops runbook + oncall rota draft

:thumbsup:
